note: The authoritative version of the OS image (AGENTS.md, Versioning and changelog). `version` is stamped into /etc/os-release (WISPOS_VERSION, VERSION_ID) by os/stage_rootfs.py; `build_id` (YYYYMMDD.N, one per image build, comparable) is stamped as BUILD_ID and is what the update scheme compares (docs/WISPOS-UPDATE-DESIGN.md). Change them here and nowhere else; docs/RELEASING.md says when.
